key.nusmp.undine_link: Undine (link or unlink Noelle's water spirit)
nusmp.undine.spirit.full: Undine cannot answer: too many spirits are out.
nusmp.undine.spirit.linked: Undine rises from the water beside you.
nusmp.undine.spirit.unlinked: Undine sinks back into the water.
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_link_2: Undine: “The water answers you, as it always has.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_link_4: Undine: “Good to see you again, my friend.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_farewell_1: Undine: “I return to the water. Call me again.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_farewell_2: Undine: “Until the tide brings us together.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_farewell_3: Undine: “Rest well. I will be listening.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_wave_1: Undine: “Rise, great sea! Crash upon them!”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_wave_2: Undine: “Hear the roar of the deep!”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_wave_3: Undine: “Drown their fury beneath the waves!”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_wave_4: Undine: “Let the ocean remember its name!”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_hurt_3: Undine: “Do not let them touch you.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_idle_3: Undine: “Every river finds the sea in the end.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_idle_4: Undine: “I can hear the rain, far away.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_idle_6: Undine: “Take your time. I am not going anywhere.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_lowhp_1: Undine: “Your strength is fading. Let me help you.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_lowhp_2: Undine: “Please, be careful. You are hurt.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_lowhp_3: Undine: “Do not give up. I am with you.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_lowhp_4: Undine: “Breathe. The water will mend you.”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_died_1: Undine: “No... come back to the water...”
subtitles.nusmp.voice.undine_died_2: Undine: “Sleep now. I will carry you home.”
